application.name: NetaWatch
application.description: Civic Intelligence & Public Accountability Platform for 543 Lok Sabha Members of Parliament
primary_sources: Lok Sabha Secretariat Hansard Records & PRS Legislative Research
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MPLADS Portal)
Supreme Court of India & High Court e-Courts National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG)

tools.name: search_politicians
tools.description: Search verified database of 543 Lok Sabha MPs by name, constituency, state, party, or alliance coalition.

parameters.query: string (optional keyword matching MP name, constituency, state, or party)

tools.name: get_politician_profile
tools.description: Retrieve verified profile dossier of a specific MP including bio, age, education, role, Form 26 affidavit verification, and core metrics.

tools.name: get_parliamentary_activity
tools.description: Retrieve official parliamentary attendance records, debates count, questions asked, private member bills, and committee memberships for an MP.

tools.name: get_political_statements_and_stances
tools.description: Retrieve verified policy stances, public positions, and recent news coverage with sentiment and source attribution for an MP.

tools.name: get_political_activity_and_initiatives
tools.description: Retrieve major landmark initiatives, career timeline milestones, and MPLADS constituency development funds.

tools.name: compare_politicians_matrix
tools.description: Perform computational head-to-head comparative analysis of 2 to 4 politicians across attendance, debates, declared wealth, criminal cases, and MPLADS delivery.

tools.name: set_comparison_view
tools.description: Actuate and control the NetaWatch user interface: syncs selected politicians into comparison tray, opens side-by-side comparison modal, and sets active analytical focus dimension.

tools.name: get_evidence_and_affidavits
tools.description: Retrieve verifiable legal cases, sworn ECI Form 26 disclosures, IPC criminal sections, asset declarations history, and flagged contractor tenders for an MP.
